title: Nathan the Prophet
lead: The prophet at David's court who brought God's promise of a lasting house, confronted David over Bathsheba and Uriah, and helped put Solomon on the throne.

sections.b: Nathan first appears when David proposes to build a house for the ark. He approves, then brings God's reply that God will build David a house (2 Samuel 7; 1 Chronicles 17). After David's sin with Bathsheba he tells the parable of the poor man's lamb and says, "You are the man" (2 Samuel 12:1–15). He names the baby Jedidiah (2 Samuel 12:25), and with Bathsheba he secures Solomon's succession against Adonijah (1 Kings 1:11–45). Chronicles credits him with records of David's and Solomon's reigns (1 Chronicles 29:29; 2 Chronicles 9:29), and Psalm 51's title recalls his visit. He is not the same as David's son Nathan (2 Samuel 5:14; Luke 3:31).
